audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns tracks Janna's Howling Gale but never states a real number, just 'matchup-defining'.
audit.why: Howling Gale is a flat 14s cooldown at all ranks — a fixed number worth stating directly, since Poppy's whole engage plan (per dosFull/loading) is to wait it out.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags: 'level chart contradicts data: Poppy wins only 47.04% but the chart gives Poppy 5/7 stages vs 2' (both content win[] and the packet's own levelChart agree Poppy wins 5 of 7 stages, yet the real winrate over 812 games has Janna favored).
audit.why: The kit supports Poppy favored early (melee dive vs a mana-fragile enabler before Zephyr/Monsoon come online) and Janna favored once R Monsoon (130/115/100s) is up, which is roughly what the current stage-by-stage chart already says — but I can't tell from the kits alone which specific stage(s) should flip to make the aggregate land at a Janna-favored 47% rather than the implied Poppy-favored split. Left alone per the DECIDED chart rule rather than guessed.

spikes[] correctly identify the level-2 all-in window before Janna can afford disengage, the level-6 Monsoon hard-peel, and the late-game teamfight blank against R+W kiting — all grounded in real Janna tools.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Steadfast Presence banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Janna Howling Gale: 14s flat — the charged tornado breaks every engage, bait it before committing the dive. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Steadfast Presence banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

notes: The winrate-vs-chart contradiction in packet.defects is real and unresolved — see audit point 2 — flagged for the phase-accuracy pass. Full-layer phases[].side is also the flat 'Skill' template on all 7 rows; left alone alongside the chart-contradiction issue since fixing one without the other risks a new mirror disagreement (galio's page already reads Poppy favored early against enablers, so a mirror check on this pair should happen at the same time as any chart resolution).
